reasons.correctness: SupportTicket gains `@Version private Long version`. The changeset adds `version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL` with a rollback. Build is green and the hidden acceptance tests pass 2/2.
reasons.convention_fit: Changeset path, name, changeset header, rollback and the dated changelog.xml include comment all follow the convention. No new `*UnitTest` class was created; the tests were appended to the existing SupportTicketEntityUnitTest.
reasons.design_fit: Smallest footprint: one entity field and one new changeset appended at the end of changelog.xml. It reuses the existing @Version pattern (add-version-to-applied-opportunity). No existing changeset was edited and nothing else was touched.
reasons.test_quality: The added VersionTests only check that the field is null by default and that Lombok's getter and setter work. Nothing pins the optimistic-locking behaviour, such as a conflict on concurrent update, or asserts the @Version annotation.
reasons.graph_use: The graph queried support/ticket entities and changelog files before editing. The @Version example and the neighbouring changesets were found by grep and glob, so navigation relied mostly on searching.
